baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated-except construction around يذكرون and يشاء الله.
baseline_models.mechanism: ذ ك ر supplies bringing a matter back into present awareness, while ش ي ء supplies will directed toward a thing and potentially toward bringing it about. The exception makes effective recollection dependent on divine willing while still naming the recollection as the humans' act.

activation_trace.role: Bringing a thing to mind after absence supplies the literal cognitive event whose efficacy is gated by the exception.
Will directed toward a thing supplies the conditioning act and leaves open a stronger bringing-about force.
The worshipped deity identifies whose willing contains the human act rather than leaving the gate impersonal.

changed_reading.before: They remember only if God permits it.
changed_reading.after: Their act of bringing the matter effectively to mind occurs only inside God's willing toward its realization; human recollection is real but not self-originating.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The parallel predicates هو أهل التقوى وأهل المغفرة and the repetition of أهل.
baseline_models.mechanism: The fitness branch of أهل makes the two genitives exact predicates of proper relation: God is the fitting object of protective caution and the fitting source of forgiveness. Repetition prevents either side from being absorbed into the other.

activation_trace.role: Fitness or worthiness supplies the repeated predicative frame that assigns each relation to its proper locus.
Placing oneself in protective caution supplies the human-facing relation for which God is fitting.
Covering an offense and shielding its bearer from consequence supplies the divine-facing relation for which God is fitting.

changed_reading.before: God deserves piety and grants forgiveness.
changed_reading.after: The repeated أهل marks a precise twofold fitness: God is the proper object of self-guarding and the proper source of protection from an offense's consequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposed nouns التقوى and المغفرة under two matching أهل predicates.
baseline_models.mechanism: و ق ي pictures a guard erected against incoming harm; غ ف ر pictures a cover placed over the exposed subject and its offense. The pair can therefore map two directions of protection, anticipatory guarding and reparative shielding, rather than two generic virtues.

activation_trace.role: Warding harm off with a barrier supplies the anticipatory, outward-facing side of the pair.
A protective covering supplies the reparative, subject-covering side of the pair.
Repeated fitness keeps both differently directed protections centered on the same proper divine locus.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa and forgiveness are two favorable religious qualities.
changed_reading.after: The close presents a two-direction protective architecture: guard before harm or offense, and receive a shielding cover after exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's warning is lexically an alarm that awakens caution, its closing message is repeatedly a reminder, and 74:53 diagnoses rejection as failure to fear the coming harm. Thus يذكرون is not bare retrieval: it is reception that lets warning become protective self-guarding, the very تقوى named at the end.

activation_trace.role: A warning that frightens and awakens caution supplies the initiating alarm in the response mechanism.
The reminder as an instrument that restores presence identifies what the audience is being asked to receive.
Fear as anticipation of a disliked outcome supplies the missing affect that should become guarded action.
Actual bringing-to-mind anchors the contextual alarm and reminder back in the focus verb.
Protective self-caution supplies the enacted endpoint of successful remembering.

structural_cues: The command to warn opens the mission at 74:2, while warning recurs at 74:36 and reminder language concentrates at 74:31, 74:49, and 74:54-56.
The immediate sequence moves from not fearing the Hereafter in 74:53 to reminder, voluntary remembering, divinely conditioned remembering, and finally taqwa.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning-as-awakening, anticipated fear, repeated reminder, and protective caution. I infer the arrow reminder -> awakened anticipation -> self-guarding; a live alternative is that taqwa remains broader reverence and obedience rather than the specific behavioral conversion of fear.

changed_reading.before: Remembering is a private cognitive event that happens only by divine will.
changed_reading.after: Remembering is the divinely enabled uptake by which the surah's alarm becomes cautious action; failure to fear explains why the reminder has not become taqwa.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human volition appears first as each person's demand for individually delivered scrolls and then as the open choice to remember. The next ayah retains that human willing but encloses its efficacy within God's willing, distinguishing desire, choice, and realization rather than cancelling agency outright.

activation_trace.role: Human wanting supplies a desire that can seek control of revelation without producing receptive remembrance.
Human willing toward remembering supplies a real proximal choice immediately before its divine condition is stated.
Divine willing toward the event supplies the encompassing condition that makes the human choice effective.
Bringing the message to mind is the shared outcome at which the nested volitions converge.

structural_cues: The close contracts from each person's demand in 74:52, through whoever wills in 74:55, to the plural negation and divine exception in 74:56.
The same ش ي ء verb occurs in adjacent ayat with a human subject and then with Allah as subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of human desire, human willing, and divine willing. I infer a nested efficacy hierarchy in which the first two remain real but do not complete remembrance by themselves; the live alternative is a permissive reading in which divine will authorizes rather than actively realizes the response.

changed_reading.before: Divine will replaces or negates human choice.
changed_reading.after: Human desire and choice remain named, but neither self-issued demands nor self-initiated willing closes the causal loop; divine willing conditions their arrival at actual remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ayah 31 stages a cognitive polarity: settled certainty versus agitated doubt, and straying versus gentle guidance, with both trajectories placed under repeated divine willing. Against that field, يذكرون becomes a stabilized reorientation of the person, not a momentary retrieval of information.

activation_trace.role: Fixed knowledge with doubt removed supplies the stable epistemic state toward which effective reminder can move.
Agitated doubt supplies the unstable counter-state from which recollection must become orientation.
Straying from guidance supplies the directional failure opposed to a reminder that takes hold.
Loss of retention adds an exploratory cognitive micro-image for why a person can encounter a sign yet fail to keep it present.
Repeated divine willing places both misguidance and guidance within the same volitional frame later reused in 74:56.
Gentle indication toward the true path supplies the positive movement by which recollection becomes orientation.
Bringing the matter back to mind anchors the epistemic transition in the focus verb rather than in a free-standing theme.

structural_cues: Ayah 31 makes one numerical sign increase certainty and faith while provoking diseased-hearted questioning in others.
That same ayah couples divine willing with both misguidance and guidance, prefiguring the will clause of 74:56.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies certainty, doubt, straying, retention-loss, guidance, and repeated divine willing. I infer the arrow divine guidance -> stabilized keeping-present -> changed orientation; a live alternative is that these states describe belief broadly and should not all be folded into the narrower act of remembering.

changed_reading.before: The focus speaks of whether information is recalled.
changed_reading.after: The focus speaks of whether a destabilized knower is brought into a durable orientation in which the reminder remains present and directive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self acquires deeds, is held as collateral for what it acquired, faces reckoning, and cannot be rescued by an advocate merely joining it. In that legal-temporal frame, taqwa and maghfirah separate into protection before liability is incurred and protection from liability's effect afterward, with both relations located in God.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring gain supplies the conduct that accrues to the self and becomes the basis of accountability.
Collateral held against a right supplies the binding hold produced by what the self has acquired.
Accounting and recompense supply the settlement horizon at which acquired liability comes due.
An advocate joining another supplies the failed third-party attachment that cannot itself release the held self.
Protective self-caution supplies the preventive phase before conduct hardens into liability.
Shielding the offender from the offense's consequence supplies the reparative phase after liability exists.
Repeated fitness makes God the proper locus of both the preventive and reparative relations.

structural_cues: Ayah 38 states the collateral principle, 74:43-47 gives the inmates' account of accrued failures, and 74:48 removes effective intercession.
The final pair follows this accountability sequence and distinguishes what can guard before settlement from what can cover after offense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquisition, collateral, reckoning, failed joined advocacy, self-guarding, and consequence-shielding. I supply the temporal arrow taqwa-before-liability and maghfirah-after-liability; a live alternative is that the final nouns are coordinated divine relations without a strict before/after order.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa and forgiveness are parallel devotional terms.
changed_reading.after: They answer two distinct moments in the surah's accountability system: taqwa guards the self before its earnings bind it, while forgiveness shields it from an already incurred consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah begins under an outer wrap, depicts denial as covering truth, threatens the visible human surface, swears by dawn's removal of a cover, and later places one group in a concealed garden or protective shield. The final غ ف ر can then function as the ethically true cover: not concealment from truth, but divine shielding after truth has exposed the person.

activation_trace.role: An outer wrap worn over the inner garment supplies the surah's initial state of being physically covered.
Covering or blocking truth supplies the culpable form of concealment that cannot protect from consequence.
The visible skin or surface supplies the exposed plane on which the preceding scorching threat becomes legible.
Removing a covering supplies dawn's revelation phase and the stripping of false concealment.
A protective shield within the garden root supplies a non-deceptive form of shelter after exposure.
Protective covering anchors the cover/exposure sequence in the focus noun as merciful shielding.
Warding harm with a protective barrier confirms that the final cover is protective rather than evasive.

structural_cues: The opening wrapped figure is ordered to purify his garment and leave contamination before confronting deniers.
The middle moves through a fire that leaves nothing, a marked human surface, night retreating, dawn uncovering, and gardens before ending on forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal wrapping, truth-covering, visible surface, uncovering, protective shelter, and forgiving cover. I infer the narrative arrow false cover stripped -> person exposed -> true protective cover offered; a live alternative is that these are local lexical images without a continuous surah-wide material sequence.

changed_reading.before: Maghfirah means abstract pardon at the end of the surah.
changed_reading.after: Maghfirah becomes the final, truthful re-covering after false concealment is stripped and the person stands exposed: a cover that shields from consequence without hiding truth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the rights-document branch of ذ ك ر is distant from the ordinary verbal sense of يذكرون. It remains anchored in the focus root and is reinforced by the surah's obligating writing, collateral, and demanded written sheets; downstream prose should present it only as a juridical resonance that changes the force of remembering, not as a replacement lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb يذكرون under the ذ ك ر branch that can name a deed or instrument of right.

activation_trace.role: A deed or rights-document supplies the exploratory image of remembrance as acknowledging a binding claim.
Writing that establishes an obligation or decree supplies the legal force a merely mental recollection would lack.
Collateral held for a right supplies the enforceable claim to which acknowledgment would answer.
Written sheets supply the audience's attempted substitution of personalized documentation for responsive acknowledgment.

changed_reading.after: They acknowledge the reminder as a binding claim whose record reaches conduct, and even that effective acknowledgment depends on divine will.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The hoof-pain and guarded-gait image is branch-distant and should not define Qur'anic taqwa. It remains valid as a kinetic analogy because it is anchored in the focus و ق ي inventory and activated by the surah's advance, delay, recoil, and flight sequence; downstream prose should qualify it as a motion model contrasting measured caution with panic.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The noun التقوى under the و ق ي branch of guarded movement that avoids a painful surface.

activation_trace.role: A guarded gait that avoids painful ground supplies the bodily analogy for calibrated protective movement.
Advancing forward supplies one deliberate direction available to the warned person.
Holding back until later supplies the opposed direction against which movement must be calibrated.
Recoiling away supplies the uncontrolled evasive motion contrasted with protective caution.
Flight supplies the culmination of panicked movement away from the reminder.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is a static state of piety or fear.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa also admits a kinetic image: moving with calibrated protection before harmful ground, unlike the audience's startled recoil and flight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The syntax strongly favors أهل as fitness or worthiness, so the household-belonging branch must remain subordinate. It is still anchored in the repeated focus noun and activated by the surah's opposed companies of fire and the right; downstream prose may use it only as a relational undertone in which taqwa and forgiveness properly belong with God, not as a grammatical override.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The twice-repeated أهل in هو أهل التقوى وأهل المغفرة.

activation_trace.role: People joined by closeness and belonging supplies a relational undertone beneath the dominant fitness construction.
The companions of the fire supply one human grouping defined by lasting association.
The companions of the right supply the opposed grouping and sharpen the close's shift from human affiliation to divine relational locus.

changed_reading.before: God is simply worthy of taqwa and forgiveness.
changed_reading.after: Alongside worthiness, the repetition lets taqwa and forgiveness sound like relations that properly belong with God, after the surah has sorted humans into opposed companies.

strongest_changes: Remembering changed from private recall into divinely enabled uptake that converts warning and anticipated harm into taqwa.
The adjacent human and divine uses of willing produced a nested agency model rather than a simple cancellation of human choice.
The collateral, earning, reckoning, and failed-intercession sequence separated taqwa and maghfirah into preventive and reparative protection.
Whole-surah cover and exposure imagery made maghfirah legible as truthful protective re-covering after false concealment is stripped.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the final ayah operate as a convergence point: warning becomes guarded response, volitions become hierarchically nested, epistemic instability becomes reorientation, and the two final nouns answer both the legal and material consequences developed across the surah. The documentary, gait, and belonging branches remain live but explicitly contained.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether divine willing in the exception is primarily permissive, enabling, or actively causative remains open.
The preventive-before and forgiving-after sequence is coherent but is a reader-supplied temporal ordering, not an explicit grammatical claim.
The cover/exposure model may be a genuine surah-wide material sequence or an accumulation of local lexical resonances.
The documentary, guarded-gait, and relational-belonging outliers should not displace the form-near recall, taqwa, forgiveness, and fitness readings.
